how.a: Fill in the form, watch the preview change as you type, and download the PDF.

required.q: Which details do I need to fill in?
required.a: You need: {required}. Everything else is optional.
required.a_more: Among others, you need: {required}. Everything else is optional.

tax.q: Does it work out the tax ({tax})?
tax.rates: Choose the rate your country uses ({rates}), or type your own.
tax.typed: Type the rate that applies to you.
tax.added: The tax is added to the prices, and the document shows the amount before tax, the tax and the total.
tax.included: The prices already include the tax, and the document shows how much of the total is tax.

signature.a: Yes, when you are logged in. Save your signatures once, then choose one on the document; choose “No signature” to leave the place empty and sign by hand. A logo is saved with your business.

free.q: Is it free, and do I need an account?
free.a: You can make a few documents every day without an account. A free account gives you more downloads, and keeps your businesses, signatures and documents so you can use them again.

country.q: Can I make it for another country or currency?
country.a: Yes. Choose the country, the language and the currency in the menu at the top of the page; the form, the tax and the way numbers and dates are written follow your choice.

official.a: No. QuickSlips makes the document from the details you enter. It is not issued by a tax authority or by an e-invoicing system, and you are responsible for the accuracy of what you enter and for using the document lawfully, for real transactions only.
